title: Euro Inox - Stainless Steels at High Temperatures, Materials and Applications Series volume 18, first edition 2012
notes: Producers' association guide, ISBN 978-2-87997-064-6, read as a PDF hosted by Informationsstelle Edelstahl Rostfrei (robots.txt allows access). Facts used by this repository, cited and not copied as tables: Table 8 gives generally accepted maximum service temperatures in air, for guidance only, of 870 C intermittent and 925 C continuous for 1.4301 (304) and 1.4541 (321); the text states that elevated water vapour can reduce the maximum recommended service temperature by 50 to 150 C; 1.4512 (409) is used extensively in automotive exhaust systems, but Table 8 gives no service temperature for it; Table 14 gives a density of 7.7 kg/dm3 for the ferritic heat-resistant grades and 7.8 to 8.0 kg/dm3 for the austenitic heat-resistant grades, 7.9 for 1.4878 (321H). These are generic guidance values for grade families. The actual grade of any 993 tip is not established by this source.
